title: Missing in the Mine
html:
Silk merchant Perrin Vale went into Rustpick Mine to inspect a shipment and never returned.

About

Given byTailor
Level20
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

Nothing to bring.

Steps

  1. Talk to Tailor (inside Binxonia - Tailor (near Binxonia)) to get the quest.
  2. Speak with Perrin Vale inside Rustpick Mine
  3. Report to the Binxonia Tailor inside Binxonia - Tailor

Rewards

Reward
Gold150
Character XP8,000
Quest points1

What Tailor says

Perrin Vale: Keep your voice down. I followed crates that should have held silk, and heard legs scraping the wood. Live spiders, every one of them.

Perrin Vale: Hobb Rusk arranged the shipment. His guards caught me reading the labels. I'll wait here until the passage clears. Tell the Tailor I'm alive.

Tailor: Perrin always did ask one question too many. I'm glad he's alive. Thank you for finding him and bringing word back.

Handing it in

"Perrin always did ask one question too many. I'm glad he's alive. Thank you for finding him and bringing word back."
